note: Normative expected outcomes for the interop matrix (docs/design/interop.md section 4). Identities are names from spec/fixtures/keys.json; the harness reads seeds, public keys and kids from that file at run time and this file never contains key material. fresh scenarios attempt a state change and run against a server started from a pristine state file; all other scenarios share one server per (client, server) pair. Expected data is matched as a subset: objects must contain every listed key with an equal value (recursively), arrays must be deep-equal, and an expected null requires an actual null. Any expected string of the form {"$kid":"<name>"} is replaced at run time by that fixture identity's kid.
